g.text: Low while the dividers are held or unpowered (G3)

g.desc: Low while the dividers are held or unpowered (G3)

g.text: 1. Function: NDK NSC5083D at 45.1584 / 49.152 MHz on MCLK_3V1 (TPS7A2031), one at a time,

g.desc: 1. Function: NDK NSC5083D at 45.1584 / 49.152 MHz on MCLK_3V1 (TPS7A2031), one at a time,

g.text: 33 Ω each into MCLK_OSC (100 kΩ pull-down); one SN74AUC1G74 per DAC divides by two (Q-bar

g.desc: 33 Ω each into MCLK_OSC (100 kΩ pull-down); one SN74AUC1G74 per DAC divides by two (Q-bar

g.text: to D, PRE-bar high), Q through 27 Ω to its XTI (ADR 0019; BOM v1 lines 20, 21, 29, 139, 140).

g.desc: to D, PRE-bar high), Q through 27 Ω to its XTI (ADR 0019; BOM v1 lines 20, 21, 29, 139, 140).

g.text: 2. Absent state: ST pulled down, dividers held by MCLK_DIV_RUN. MCLK_3V1 EN = AUDIO_LN_EN AND

g.desc: 2. Absent state: ST pulled down, dividers held by MCLK_DIV_RUN. MCLK_3V1 EN = AUDIO_LN_EN AND

g.text: DAC_DIG_1V8 (SN74LVC1G57 with In0 high: Y = In1 AND In2, SCES414P Table 1) and MCLK_1V8

g.desc: DAC_DIG_1V8 (SN74LVC1G57 with In0 high: Y = In1 AND In2, SCES414P Table 1) and MCLK_1V8

g.text: EN = DAC_DIG_1V8, so no clock reaches an unpowered XTI (G3).

g.desc: EN = DAC_DIG_1V8, so no clock reaches an unpowered XTI (G3).

g.text: 3. Start (ADR 0019 item 6): ST and CLR-bar low before the rails; CLR-bar released while

g.desc: 3. Start (ADR 0019 item 6): ST and CLR-bar low before the rails; CLR-bar released while

g.text: MCLK_OSC is low; then one ST high. Family change: DACs to the RCO, CLR-bar low, swap ST.

g.desc: MCLK_OSC is low; then one ST high. Family change: DACs to the RCO, CLR-bar low, swap ST.

g.text: 4. Layout (item 5): one cluster; oscillator to divider <= 10 mm, divider to XTI <= 15 mm.

g.desc: 4. Layout (item 5): one cluster; oscillator to divider <= 10 mm, divider to XTI <= 15 mm.

g.text: 5. Open: ST rating at 3.3 V drive into a 3.1 V or unpowered oscillator (pinout O11);

g.desc: 5. Open: ST rating at 3.3 V drive into a 3.1 V or unpowered oscillator (pinout O11);
